protocol: fixed 0887 paired MCE attribute-storage candidate capture

native.order: AB/BA alternates by (block + case_index) parity; each case has four before-first and four after-first pairs

schedule.execution: native lane completes before allocator lane; every row launches a fresh binary process pinned to CPU 12 with warm filesystem cache and fail-fast semantics

statistics.pairing: after/before ratios are computed within each scheduled pair; samples are never pooled across children
statistics.primary_gate: root gate must require native primary p50 median ratio <= 0.98 and bootstrap upper endpoint < 1.0
statistics.control_review: retain every ordinary XLSX, DOCX, and PPTX control metric whose paired after/before ratio exceeds 1.05
statistics.spread_review: retain every native p50 leg whose max/min ratio exceeds 1.20
statistics.primary_review: retain every primary XLSX producer pair metric (p50, p95, p99, and peak RSS) whose after/before ratio exceeds 1.05; this is review evidence and does not change the primary p50 gate.

semantic_artifacts.primary: The XLSX producer full-cell scan reuses the 0885 verifier: archive identity, counts, canonical digest, refusal census, source-version fence, route eligibility, sample alignment, producer sidecar, and allocator zero-failure checks are validated per child.
semantic_artifacts.controls: The ordinary XLSX corpus is pinned by its sealed baseline report; DOCX selected-paragraph and PPTX selected-slide runs validate the expected selected text on every sample and retain exact producer sidecars.
semantic_artifacts.rss: External /usr/bin/time %M is retained as process-lifetime peak RSS in KiB and is reduced separately from allocator operation counters.

verified: The frozen schedule is correctly counterbalanced within every native case and the allocator primary lane.
The reducer recomputes raw quantiles from sorted elapsed vectors and records every pair, ratio, bootstrap draw configuration, control flag, and spread flag without retries or replacement.
Allocator counters are summarized from per-child medians and remain a separate primary observation with adoption explicitly not evaluated.
The capture driver binds binary identity at launch, checks report identity and sealed corpus equality, preserves raw evidence, and stops on a child or semantic failure.
The reducer also records primary pair review flags for p50, p95, p99, and peak RSS when any pair ratio exceeds 1.05, separately from the adoption gate.
caveats: The reducer's top-level status is an evidence-reduction status and is unconditionally pass; it must not be interpreted as candidate adoption. Root gate checks must inspect the primary gate, control flags, spread flags, build/quality receipts, and semantic receipts before any comparison claim.

Before capture, the root plan must bind the exact experiment/reduction helper hashes, retained 0885 binaries, candidate build/source receipts, all four sealed baseline-qualification report hashes, producer sidecars, and the taskset/environment descriptors.
CPU affinity is recorded without an exclusive-host guarantee. Warm-cache timings and external RSS are descriptive process observations, not native Office, cold-cache, or universal producer claims.
required_followups: Freeze the plan only after the isolated candidate build and quality gates pass.
Run the 72-child capture once with no retries or replacements, then reduce from retained receipts and raw reports.
Review every emitted control and spread flag and retain the complete reduction output; do not infer a speedup from allocator counters or RSS alone.

experiment_helper.reason: The review packet had a transcription error; the helper was rehashed from the reviewed file before freeze validation.

reduction_helper.reason: The reducer gained primary metric review flags; the helper was rehashed from the reviewed file before freeze validation.
